Module np.cincuentazo
Package np.cincuentazo.model

Class MachinePlayer

java.lang.Object
np.cincuentazo.model.Player
np.cincuentazo.model.MachinePlayer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Playable
public class MachinePlayer extends Player
Represents an AI-controlled player in Cincuentazo.

Strategy

The machine uses an aggressive strategy: among all legally playable cards, it always picks the one that results in the highest table sum (without exceeding 50). This maximises the pressure on the next player by leaving them as little room as possible.

This is intentionally kept simple for a first implementation. A more advanced strategy could consider the probability of the next player being able to respond, or weigh saving J/Q/K cards for high-sum situations.

Thread safety note

chooseBestCardIndex(int) is called from a background thread (MachinePlayerThread) and must therefore operate only on model state â€” no JavaFX calls, no shared mutable state beyond the hand (which is not modified here). The actual selectCard(int, int) call happens on the JavaFX Application Thread, coordinated by the controller via Platform.runLater().

      Plays the card at the given index on behalf of the machine.

      This method is called by the controller on the JavaFX Application Thread after the background thread has already computed the best card index via chooseBestCardIndex(int).

    • chooseBestCardIndex

      public int chooseBestCardIndex(int tableSum)
      Determines the index of the best card to play from the machine's hand, given the current table sum. Algorithm
      1. Filter the hand for legally playable cards.
      2. Among playable cards, pick the one that maximises tableSum + card.getValue(tableSum) â€” the highest resulting table sum without busting.
      3. Return the index of that card in the full hand list.

      This method is read-only: it does not modify the hand. It is safe to call from any thread.

      Parameters:
      tableSum - the current table sum
      Returns:
      the 0-based index in the hand of the best card to play
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the machine has no playable cards â€” the caller (MachinePlayerThread) should have checked Player.canPlay(int) first
